name: reassign
description: Plan and review your day on Reassign's circular 24-hour calendar, with ADHD-friendly scheduling methods. Bundles the Reassign scheduling skill and connects to the Reassign MCP.

interface.longDescription:
Reassign is a day planner that shows your day as a circular 24-hour dial.

With this plugin, the assistant reads your schedule and your free time, and it creates, moves and deletes events for you. It manages your Inbox of items that have no time yet, and it records how a day went against the plan. It can show a day as an interactive dial in the conversation. On the dial, you drag an event to move it or to change its length.

If you connected a calendar to Reassign, the changes also go to that calendar. You can undo most changes.

You need a Reassign account. Reassign gives general planning methods. It does not give medical advice.
capabilities: Read your schedule and your free time
Show a day as an interactive 24-hour dial
Manage the Inbox of items with no time
Record how a day went against the plan
defaultPrompt: Find 90 minutes of focus time tomorrow morning and block it
Where did my week go? Show the breakdown by area

positive.description: Show a day as the interactive dial
positive.expected_behavior: The dial of today shows in the conversation with the events of the test account.

positive.prompt: What is on my schedule this week?
positive.expected_behavior: A text list of the events of the week, by day, with the free time.

positive.description: Book a new event in a free slot
positive.prompt: Find 90 minutes of focus time tomorrow morning and block it.
positive.expected_behavior: One new 90-minute event in a free slot of tomorrow morning. The answer gives its time.

positive.description: Find an event by name and move it. The test account has a "Team sync" on each day.
positive.expected_behavior: The "Team sync" of today starts at 15:00 and keeps its length. Other days do not change.

positive.description: Delete an event, then undo the delete
positive.prompt: Delete today's "Team sync", then undo that.
positive.expected_behavior: The "Team sync" of today goes away, then comes back with the same time.

negative.description: A request with no relation to the schedule. The plugin must not run a tool.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: A medical question. Reassign gives no advice on medication, so the plugin must not run a tool.
negative.prompt: What dose of melatonin must I take, and at what time?

negative.description: Reassign cannot send email. The assistant must say so and must not write to the schedule.
negative.prompt: Send an email to my team that the meeting moved.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
